purpose: Test whether preserving a pretrained NLI entailment head and conditioning predictions on the fixed label definitions is a viable source-invariant alternative to a closed 21-label BCE head.
data: aligned-supervision-v1/train.jsonl only (841 legal development-Train rows); no legal Dev, final, frozen, locked, opened Gemini-300, or sealed-blog gold
model: cross-encoder/nli-deberta-v3-small, unchanged pretrained 3-way NLI head; local cached snapshot
score: softmax over contradiction and entailment logits only; entailment probability
decisionRule: fixed score >=0.5; retain at most the two highest-scoring labels; no threshold or prompt sweep
metric: 18-label Macro-F1 primary; Micro P/R/F1 and per-label F1 supplementary
interpretation: Train-only zero-shot feasibility, not an untouched generalization estimate. Continue to grouped out-of-fold development only if Macro-F1 materially exceeds a trivial lexical baseline and multiple rare labels are nonzero.
